scope: Actual app-wide quick-export presets and strict file.quick_export reuse existing image export; closes the current quick/explicit export composite row. Includes native sheet dimension layout and text shortcut routing fixes found manually. Not full Photoshop or final AI closure.

core_targeted.note: Six new preset/export and six previous export option cases. Later full core covers the same final Rust production path and publication metadata counter.

native_after_layout_and_sheet_routing_fi.note: Final native-only fixes retested relevant suites; not another complete native-suite run.

required_metal.reference: Preset changes and actual8x6 16-bit PNG export keep the current frame byte-exact and document archive/revision unchanged.

lint.note: Final native-only fixes recompiled by related XCTest/Release and checked by final Swiftlint; no Rust code changed after full Rust/lint/Metal.

commands.note: New quick default example actually writes16x16PNG. Registered params/examples remained the same through final publication pin; pin behavior is covered by subsequent full core/native/Metal.

semantics.settings: Strict typed options; app-wide shared store across independent engines; native persists validated options only. Whole options replacement; omitted values reset defaults. Canonical equality is a version no-op. No document/history/dirty/project-path changes.
semantics.capabilities: Settings carry no path/folder/file token/overwrite grant. Each export uses a fresh source-bound one-use write resource, destination stamp and overwrite permission.
semantics.ai: Settings approval always separate in Direct and AskFirst; declining preserves defaults and approving does not grant ordinary edit approval. File picker authorization remains independent.
semantics.publication: Request-bound document/revision and captured preset version checked before publication. A short metadata publication marker prevents changing presets during disk encoding without blocking other engines queries on disk I/O; concurrent settings writes reject with retry message. Guard drops on success/failure.
semantics.encoding: Existing export path; original8/16-bit PNG/TIFF, explicit16->8 JPEG/WebP consent, WebP lossless/lossy rules, JPEG output-space matte, ICC/DPI and premultiplied linear area/bilinear resize. Sources untouched.
semantics.native: Original dimensions vs fixed size are explicit; UInt64 preset version; custom RGB matte retained; malformed persisted settings blocked globally; attached-sheet text commands do not fall through to canvas. Stop remains available.

manual.method: Live native CUA AX states, keyboard and screenshots; no persisted screenshot artifact claim.
manual.round1_finding: Initial width field compressed. Cmd+A in sheet routed to main canvas and created two select-all histories. Cancelled unsaved preset, undid both fixture selections, verified clean/Undo disabled and normal quit. No image file written in that round.

Shortcut quick export wrote JPEG256x384. Changed PNG/original size then wrote1024x1536PNG. Document stayed clean, one original pixel layer, no selection, Undo disabled; normal quit.
manual.round3_restoration: CLI post-exit verification found previous popup restoration had retained explicitsrgb. Reopened only one instance, actual persisted PNG/original-size/sRGB readback confirmed; selected preserve working ICC and saved, read validated target_space=null; clean document then normal quit.
manual.output_limits: Both manually exported files used explicit sRGB; final preserve-ICC default restored afterward. All formats and16-bit/alpha/ICC numerical/persistence/concurrency claims use automated tests, not this single8-bit sample.
